# Setup (libraries and data)

## libraries

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false

library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
```

## data

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false

afabae_n4_pruning <- read.csv("afabae_n4_pruning.csv")
head(afabae_n4_pruning)
```

#  Plots

```{r}
p1 <- ggplot(afabae_n4_pruning, aes(x=correlation_threshold, y=n_snp_pruned_out)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(title="Number of SNPs removed in (1000kb windows) \nper chromosome as a function of correlation threshold)",
       x="Correlation threshold (R2)",
       y="Number of SNPs pruned") +
  facet_wrap(~chromosome, scales="free_y") +
  theme(strip.background = element_rect(fill="lightgrey")) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.1))
p1  
```

```{r}
# save figure
ggsave(plot = p1, filename = "afabae_n4_pruning_plot.pdf", width=8, height=6)
```

## Running Code

When you click the **Render** button a document will be generated that includes both content and the output of embedded code. You can embed code like this:

```{r}
1 + 1
```

You can add options to executable code like this

```{r}
#| echo: false
2 * 2
```

The `echo: false` option disables the printing of code (only output is displayed).
